answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, split across independent auditors, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the glacier of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A garden of per-task receipts records who did what, and the umber of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
